fixes.title: Let shoppers check out as a guest
fixes.why: The cart's first step asks for a password and offers no guest option, so an agent buying for someone stops there. This check is a heuristic.
fixes.how: Add a visible 'Continue as guest' option on the cart page that only asks for an email address.

fixes.title: Stop blocking agents from the mug page
fixes.why: The Enamel Mug product page answered with HTTP 403, a bot wall, so agents cannot see the product at all.
fixes.how: Adjust the bot protection rules so product pages are served normally to well-behaved crawlers; keep challenges for abusive traffic only.

fixes.title: Make every product page readable without JavaScript
fixes.why: The kettle page shows its name and price in the HTML, but the mug page shows neither because it is walled.
fixes.how: Once the wall is lifted, make sure the mug page renders its name and price on the server like the kettle page does.

fixes.title: Add a returns policy page
fixes.why: Agents compare return terms before buying.
fixes.how: Publish a returns page and link it from the footer.

fixes.title: Add Product data to every product page
fixes.why: The secret sale page has no Product data either.

fixes.title: Give the mug page an add-to-cart button
fixes.why: As check B2 shows, most text needs JavaScript, and the mug page has no add-to-cart control.
fixes.how: Add a real button named 'Add to cart'.
